description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log messages. It implements LogNode interface to receive log data, format it with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and appends it to the view. It also supports chaining to other LogNode instances for further processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log data to the LogView, supporting different log levels, including optional exception details, and forwarding the log to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
